dimensions.hierarchy: One clear focal point per view; the most important information and the primary action read first; secondary content is visibly subordinate; grouping matches meaning.
dimensions.typography: Deliberate type scale with few sizes; appropriate faces for the brief; comfortable line length and line height; weights used for hierarchy, not noise; no default-looking system typography unless the brief calls for it.
dimensions.spacing: Spacing and alignment: consistent rhythm (a small set of spacing steps), shared edges and gutters, consistent internal padding, nothing cramped or floating, grids that actually align.
dimensions.color: Restrained palette with one accent used for action/state; sufficient contrast; status colors meaningful; no muddy or clashing combinations; no 'AI-default' purple-gradient look unless asked.
dimensions.content: Copy and data match the brief exactly, are realistic (non-round, plausible), complete, free of placeholders and of invented sections the brief did not ask for.
dimensions.assets: Icons from one coherent set, images real and relevant with sensible crops; no broken images, gray boxes, emoji-as-icons or mismatched illustration styles. If the brief disallows photos, judge icon/chart/avatar quality instead.
dimensions.consistency: Components of the same kind look the same (buttons, cards, badges, rows); radii, borders, shadows and states are systematic across the screen.

anchors.1-2: Broken or unusable: overlapping/clipped text, missing major sections, unreadable.
anchors.3-4: Generic or clearly flawed: template look, obvious misalignment, inconsistent components.
anchors.5-6: Competent but unremarkable: works, minor inconsistencies, little intent.
anchors.7-8: Polished and intentional: a designer would ship it with small tweaks.
anchors.9-10: Exceptional: distinctive, fully consistent, nothing to fix at this zoom level. Use rarely.

criticalDefects: Text clipped, overlapping other text, or overflowing its container
Body or label text unreadable (too small, or contrast clearly below 4.5:1)
Placeholder text left in (Lorem, Title, Button, Label, Heading, Card)
Broken image icon, empty gray image box, or missing required image
Required section or required data missing or wrong
Content cut off by the viewport edge when the brief required it to fit
Elements stacked at (0,0) or otherwise collapsed layout
